time.label: Transaction Hour (0–23)
time.description: Hour of the day when the transaction was initiated. Peak evening hours (18:00–22:00) experience elevated concurrency.

user_latency.label: User Network Latency
user_latency.description: Round-trip network latency between the customer device and the FinPath edge gateway. Baseline mean is ~50ms.

server_latency.label: Server Processing Latency
server_latency.description: Internal microservice orchestration and validation time. Values above 90ms indicate server processing contention.

bank_latency.label: Bank Gateway Latency
bank_latency.description: Response time from the upstream acquiring/issuing bank network. Values above 80ms correlate strongly with timeout failures.

load.label: Concurrent System Load
load.description: Active concurrent transactions per second across the platform. Loads above 20,000 req/s increase queue contention.
